name: DCSFlightpanels
summary: Drives Saitek/Logitech flight panels and Stream Decks for DCS, via DCS-BIOS or key emulation.
description: Supports Saitek/Logitech switch, multi, radio, TPM and BIP panels plus Elgato Stream Deck models, mapping them to DCS controls via DCS-BIOS or keyboard emulation. It is a separate program distributed as a zip.
